scenario: count_of is the exact per-value frequency over the sliding window (LSER.16.6.1). Asserting error, info, error, the count of "error" the predicate sees reaches 2 once both error tags are absorbed; the interleaved "info" is not counted. Pin: a rule gated `count_of(e.tag, "error") >= 2` fires (action_log).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    tag: String mutable

series Event.tag:
    count_of sliding 5_s

rule check:
    Event e where count_of(e.tag, "error") >= 2
->
    log info "two errors"
